Package io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.bc

Class Ed25519PublicKeys

java.lang.Object
io.jans.lock.trace.crypto.bc.Ed25519PublicKeys
public final class Ed25519PublicKeys extends Object
Builds Ed25519 PublicKeys from RFC 8037 OKP JWKs ({"kty":"OKP","crv":"Ed25519","x":"<32 raw bytes, base64url>"}) through the JCA KeyFactory of the installed BouncyCastle provider (standard or FIPS), so no BC-internal class is referenced.

The raw 32-byte key is wrapped in the RFC 8410 SubjectPublicKeyInfo DER structure (30 2a 30 05 06 03 2b 65 70 03 21 00 || raw), the only public-key encoding every JCA provider is required to understand.

Not reused on purpose: io.jans.as.model.crypto.AbstractCryptoProvider and EDDSASigner treat x as a full SPKI blob (non-RFC-8037) and refuse FIPS mode.

Author:
Yuriy Movchan

  • Method Details

    • thumbprint

      public static String thumbprint(Map<String,String> jwk)
      RFC 7638 / RFC 8037 §A.3 JWK thumbprint of an Ed25519 key in the TRACE hash format : "sha256:" + lowercaseHex(SHA-256(UTF-8( '{"crv":"Ed25519","kty":"OKP","x":"<x>"}'))). The required members are written in lexicographic order with no whitespace; the JWK's x is used exactly as stored, and no other member can influence the result (the input is not built from the map).
      Throws:
      TraceCryptoException - with reason jwk_format when the JWK is null or has no x, or jwk_x_encoding when x is not an unpadded base64url encoding of 32 bytes

    • fromJwk

      public static PublicKey fromJwk(Map<String,String> jwk)
      Builds the public key from a JWK given as a string map (the shape stored in jansTracePublicKeyJwk). Members other than kty, crv, x and d are ignored.
      Throws:
      TraceCryptoException - with reason jwk_format, jwk_kty, jwk_crv, jwk_private_material, jwk_x_encoding, jwk_x_length, invalid_key or crypto_unavailable

    • fromJwk
